verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-catalog search and data API, reachable through an SDK, CLI and MCP server. It does not host user-defined automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations falls outside its product category. The changelog's /v1 path-versioning and semver releases describe the vendor's own API versions, not user automations, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
